definitions.gloss: to go out to meet, to greet
definitions.explanation: To go to a place to meet and welcome someone who is arriving.
To greet someone upon their arrival.

examples.english: I went to the station to meet my mother.

examples.english: I went to the airport to meet my friend.

notes:
{出迎|でむか}える is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to go out to meet and welcome someone.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to go out) + ⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to greet) → to go out to greet

TRANSITIVITY:
- {出迎|でむか}える (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧): to go out to meet someone
- Opposite: ⟦{見送|みおく}る→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧ (to see off)

ASPECT (ている):
{出迎|でむか}えている indicates waiting to greet someone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出迎|でむか}えに⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (go to the airport to meet)
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧まで{出迎|でむか}える (meet at the station)
- ⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{出迎|でむか}える (greet with a smile)

RELATED NOUN:
- {出迎|でむか}え: greeting, reception; {出迎|でむか}えに⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ = go to meet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見送|みおく}る→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧: to see off (when someone is leaving)
